extra.message: Django ORM .get() call not wrapped in try/except. .get() raises DoesNotExist (not None) when no row matches, and MultipleObjectsReturned when more than one matches — a common Django anti-pattern is to check "if not result" afterwards, which is dead code because the exception is raised before that line runs. Verify whether a framework-level exception handler already converts this into a clean error response before concluding this is a true positive.
